description: "Resolve [domain]" / "what IP does [site] point at" / "A records for [X]" — forward DNS lookup via HackerTarget, returning the A/AAAA/MX/NS/SOA records the resolver holds for a hostname. Use to check where a domain currently points, or to confirm a DNS change has propagated.

target.description: Hostname to resolve, e.g. "pipeworx.io". Not a URL — strip the scheme and path.
